en:
D-Dammit, Kiryu!
Yer not gonna get away with this!

I'm not interested in your sniveling.
You're the ones who attacked me, remember?

Then why don't y'kill me, huh? C'mon!
I'm ready t'die if yer that pissed off!

Do it, y'bastard!
Jus' hurry up n' kill me!

Shut up, would you? You're just shouting
so your friends nearby will hear you.

Tell me. Why is the Yomei Alliance
looking for Patriarch Hirose?

I-I dunno. We're jus' doin' what
Captain Koshimizu told us t'do.

A-All he said is t'find Hirose n'
the baby n' take 'em prisoner.
That's all I know!
S-Seriously!

What about Masuzoe?
Do you know where he is?

Patriarch Masuzoe? I heard he's
s'posed t'be in Tokyo fer work.
And what kind of work would that be?

Some kinda pact with that guy
Someya from the Tojo Clan.

Interesting. In that case, it seems
like he's been lying to you.

Wh-What're y'sayin'?
Whaddya know about Patriarch Masuzoe?
I'm sure you'll find out soon enough.

Y'piece o' shit, Kiryu.
I'm gonna kill ya someday!

If you're not looking for another pounding,
I suggest you keep those thoughts to yourself.

(This is the place Hirose-san got those
matches from. Snack Hourglass.)
Snack Hourglass... This is the place.
Excuse me, do you work here?

Hm? I haven't seen ya
'round these parts before.

I actually don't open the bar too often.
I'm surprised y'managed t'find the place.
Or did someone tell ya about us?

I'm looking for someone
who had these matches.

Specifically, the patriarch of the
Hirose Family. Has he come by recently?

I didn't expect ya t'get here
so quickly, Kiryu-san.
How do you know who I am?

Patriarch Hirose told me 'imself. Stopped
by before I opened up the bar today.

I've got a message he wanted me t'tell ya.
He said y'should head over t'Ryunan Shrine.
Y'know the place?

Yeah. The Mama from Snack Kiyomi
brought me there just the other day.

Kiyomi-san, huh? I guess nice men like
yerself prefer pretty bartenders like her.

Was the boss carrying a baby
when he was over here?
Oh, yes. It was mighty cute, too.
Great. You've been a huge help.
Oh, it was nothin'.

There's somethin' I wanna talk t'Hirose
about. Has t'do with a baby.
So, y'know where the old man is?

I have something I need to
talk to you about as well.

What do you want with Haruto?
Why is he so important to you?

A captain like yourself should
be able to tell me that.

So y'won't say. Guess we're jus' gonna
have t'beat the answers we want out.
Seems that way.

Y'know, I've been hopin' fer this
ever since the day we met.
You'll come to regret that soon.
I ain't so sure 'bout that!
Well then, where should I start?

Oh, right. I should probly apologize
to you before any of that.

Kiryu-san. I'm sorry fer taking your kid.
I shouldn't have gone dark like that.

Koshimizu's boys were out lookin' for him,
though. I didn't have much choice.

Y'could at least've let us know
what y'were thinkin'.

We thought you'd up n' kidnapped
Haruto or somethin' at first.

But there's more to it than that.
I wasn't sure if I should involve you guys.

Well, I've been hidin' something from
all of you for a long time now.
That includes you, Kiryu-san.

It's about Haruka Sawamura
and her baby.

From her leaving this town until the accident
in Kamurocho, I'd been looking after them.
H-Hirose-san, are y'serious!?

But y'never mentioned any
o' that stuff t'us before!
Why didn't y'tell us!?

I had my reasons for keeping all
this surveillance a secret.

From the second that kid was born,
he's been destined t'have people after him.

And as Kiryu-san figured out in Kamurocho,
Tatsukawa isn't the boy's father.
But that's a separate issue.

As for the kid's value... It all comes
back to the true identity of his father.

Now then, we were just gettin' to
how I can be sure Yuta is the father.

It all has to do with when Masuzoe and
Tatsukawa first noticed Haruka's pregnancy.

Truth is, they've been keeping an eye
on Yuta since he was a little boy.
You watched Yuta?

Wh-Why is that?
Why were the two of them watching me!?

Because, you are the heir
to the Saio Triad.

Yuta Usami. You are the biological son
of the Saio Triad ringleader, Big Lo.
Wh-What are you talking about?

But according to Lo, his son Jimmy was
murdered in Kamurocho three months ago.
Care to explain, Masuzoe!?

Jimmy was a legitimate son of his, yes.
Yuta is simply his younger brother.

And upon Jimmy's death in Kamurocho,
the Saio Triad passes to the next of kin.

Put it in terms Kiryu-san's gonna
understand, Masuzoe.

The Saio Triad has survived through the
brutal conflict in mainland China for ages.

That said, we've consistently been plagued by
betrayal from subordinates who desire power.

To put a stop to that, the Saio leadership
put their faith in the power of their blood.
Their blood? Like a lineage?

Exactly. The boss makes officers of his
family, and that keeps him safe.
Take Ed. He's the boss's cousin.

But the golden rule is that only the
boss's biological son can inherit the triad.

Can you imagine if the boss were
to have more than one son, though?
A war of succession.

Each heir would form their own separate
faction and tear the triad apart from within.

To avoid that, past Saio bosses have
opted to exile any sons past the first.

These estranged sons act as an insurance
policy, if something should befall the first.

So yer sayin' Yuta's
the insurance here?

Now hold on a sec.
Does that mean he's Chinese?

There's no way. You can't expect me
to believe something like that!
I suppose that's your call to make.

But you never knew your parents, did you?
And remember your childhood in the orphanage?

Since you were a baby, Tatsukawa and I
have been protecting you from the shadows.

We had to make sure you never knew the truth.
Make sure you didn't get yourself killed.

Those were our orders direct
from the Saio Triad leadership.

We were nothing more than discarded
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind> when the Saio Triad took us in.

What choice did we have but
to accept their way of life!?

And that's why Tatsukawa
became my friend?
Was none of it real?

Do you remember why you asked
him to teach you Chinese?

I'm the one who arranged that cute girl
to come here and motivate you to study.

All so you'd be ready on the
off chance you actually became the heir.

Tatsukawa allowed us to monitor you
closely without you even realizing.
How recently were you doing this?

All through your little tryst with Haruka.
We were aware of every last detail.

That's how we came to know she
was pregnant before anyone else.

But being the fool you are, you continued
on with your life like nothing ever happened.

And that's why you and Tatsukawa tried to
convince Haruka to abort him, right?

I get it now. That must've been the call
Kiyomi-san overheard in her bar!

The one where Tatsukawa was sayin'
t'get rid o' the baby!

We could never allow the family lineage
to be sullied by inferior Japanese blood.

And worse still, it'd be disastrous for our
backup heir to go around pumping out kids.

It was our job to pluck out
those weeds before they grew.
Y'can't talk about kids like that, asshole!

But before we could do that, Haruka
disappeared from town without a trace.

And go figure, this guy here was the one
who made sure she did. Right, Hirose-san?

I was out wanderin' through town
one day when she came up to me.
It looked like she'd seen a ghost.

Makes sense, though. She'd just found out
her beau was heir to the Saio Triad.

That, and his keepers were telling
her to get rid of her baby.
Be a shock to anyone, wouldn't it?

Took her a'while to calm down
and tell me the whole story.

Well, I was as bored
then as I am now.

But she wasn't about to let 'em
kill the life inside her.

'Specially not just to satisfy some
faceless gang of Chinese thugs.

Haruka wanted to give her boy the
respect he deserved. She was firm on that.

Even before Haruto was born, his mother
cared about him more than anything else.

And in order to help her son, she needed
somewhere safe. That's where I came in.

It's his fault that we lost track
of Haruka after she skipped town.

However, we still had time before
we had to report it up to the boss.

After all, at the time, Yuta Usami
was just an insurance policy.

If Tatsukawa and I kept our mouths shut,
not even Yuta would be the wiser.

We should have been able to live our
lives like nothing had ever happened.

Even through the Saio expansion in Kamurocho,
Tatsukawa and I kept the boy a secret.
But that's when things went off the rails.

You mean because Lo's eldest son ended up
dead at the hands of Tsuneo Iwami?
Yeah. Exactly.

Jimmy's death meant Yuta was no longer just
insurance. He was the true heir to the triad.

That led the Saio to pry into Yuta's past
in preparation for his eventual ascension.

At that point, it was only a matter of time
until they figured out our fuck-up.

That's why Tatsukawa and I were
so desperate to track Haruka down.

We needed to find the baby and report it
ourselves before the triad found out.

It seemed like that was the only way
we'd be able to save ourselves.

Tatsukawa was the one who
eventually found Haruka and the child.

Hirose-san had hidden them in a tiny rural
village just a stone's throw away from here.

Soon as we had that, we reported it
up, in detail, to the boss. His order?
Show no hesitation in eliminating the child.
Y'goddamn savages! What's yer damage!?

Y'were seriously gonna try n'
murder this little kid!? Huh!?

I didn't take Lo for being so hung up on
something as meaningless as blood ties.

It may seem inconsequential to you, but
things are different in the Saio Triad.
To us, there is no higher law.
Consider it a cultural difference.

Anyway, once we pinned down the baby,
all we had to do was wait for our chance.

We needed to lure Haruka away from
Hirose-san's watchful eye first, though.

After all, would Yuta willingly become the
Saio boss if he knew we'd killed his son?

But, before we could carry out the plan,
something unexpected happened.

Even though Tatsukawa had been told
by the boss to eliminate the child...

...Instead he tried to betray us and sell
the baby to our enemy, Tsuneo Iwami.

He figured, even if we followed orders,
the Saio might kill us for what we knew.
That's why he turned to Tsuneo.

He brought Haruka to Kamurocho in secret
so he could give the baby over to the Yomei.
But just as she arrived, his plan crumbled.

That day, Haruka was in a hit-and-run in
Kamurocho. The driver was Tatsukawa.

T-Tatsukawa's the one who hit Haruka-chan!?
Why would he do that!?

If I had to guess, I'd say the accident
wasn't the outcome he'd hoped for.

Case in point, he didn't even take
the baby with him afterward.

So you're saying Tatsukawa hit Haruka.
Are you absolutely sure of that?

And once all the dust settled, the baby
we had searched so tirelessly for...

...Somehow had found its way right
into the arms of the Dragon of Dojima.

Goddammit.
I don't get any o' this shit...

[Boss, we have the baby!
Let's get out of here already!]

Kiryu-san. This isn't exactly how
I envisioned our reunion taking place.
You'll have to excuse me for today.

(Is Haruto okay? And what
about Yuta and the others?)
Where's Haruto?
I had to let go of him on my way back.

Cap's on the run with him now.
I just hope he can shake those guys off.
So you don't know where he is?

No, but I'm sure he'll circle back
t'the family office soon enough.
Hey, Aniki...

Look, I know you're mad at me about
what happened with Haruka-san.
Oh, Aniki! I figured ya'd be here.
Nagumo. Where is Haruto!?

Lemme apologize fer that!
Those guys from before stole 'im from me...

N' after they took 'im,
they sped off in some kinda boat.
A boat? We'll never catch them now!

Y'can't jus' give up like that!
Don't y'care about what happens t'yer kid!?

Of course I do! I jus' don't know
how to process all this, though.

Not only is Haruto my son, but I'm
also the heir to a freakin' Chinese mafia?
The words hardly make sense.

Get it together, y'sad sack!
Ino's gettin' a boat ready fer us.

'Parently the fishermen're
gonna pitch in on the search too.

If nothin' else, we gotta come together
n' do this fer Haruka-san.

That includes you, Aniki.
I'll show y'to Ino's boat.

The boss n' the others're
already down there. C'mon!
Hey. The hell're y'doin', Yuta!?
Aniki. Ino said t'meet him by the dock.
What am I s'posed to do?
